blocks.text: 乘法法则——由条件概率的定义得到：

blocks.tex: P(x,y\mid\mathcal H)=P(x\mid y,\mathcal H)P(y\mid\mathcal H)=P(y\mid x,\mathcal H)P(x\mid\mathcal H).
blocks.text: $$P(x,y\mid\mathcal H)=P(x\mid y,\mathcal H)P(y\mid\mathcal H)=P(y\mid x,\mathcal H)P(x\mid\mathcal H).\tag{2.6}$$

blocks.text: 这条法则也称为链式法则。
求和法则——把边缘概率的定义改写为
$$P(x\mid\mathcal H)=\sum_y P(x,y\mid\mathcal H)\tag{2.7}$$
$$=\sum_y P(x\mid y,\mathcal H)P(y\mid\mathcal H).\tag{2.8}$$

blocks.text: $$P(y\mid x,\mathcal H)=\frac{P(x\mid y,\mathcal H)P(y\mid\mathcal H)}{P(x\mid\mathcal H)}\tag{2.9}$$
